outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the handle (frames 75–86, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 100–115, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws (frames 125–151, wrist_image); the drawer remains visibly open at frame 151 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
